title: Records
hints: README 'New syntax': record construction for newMonk, update syntax for train and promote, field getters (`xp m`, `belt m`) everywhere.

newMonk: build a Monk with all three fields. train: a copy with xp increased. promote: if the belt is already the last (maxBound), return m unchanged, else bump it with succ. ready: compare xp. graduates: the names of the ready ones (comprehension, or filter then map).
Other data: `tom { lives = lives tom - 1 }` · `succ Small` → Medium · `size == maxBound` checks for the last value · `[catName c | c <- cats, lives c > 0]`.
`train n m = m { xp = xp m + n }` · `promote m | belt m == maxBound = m | otherwise = m { belt = succ (belt m) }`.
